cases.setup: Load actual source-bound browser export; negative cases inject literal missing-value/overlap or displaced/false marker faults.
cases.observable: Exact values and geometry or exact source marker with no invalid accepted rows.
cases.red_expectation: Missing/overlapped values or a false geographic marker pass the auditor.
cases.green_expectation: Valid measured browser rows accepted; injected faults explicitly rejected.
cases.distinct_reason: Read short and long values positive
